dog.description_text:
Meet handsome Brunson!

At just 2 years old, Brunson is already a starting lineup kind of guy! This friendly pup is smart, quick on his feet, and a FAST learner—he’s got that same work-hard, give-it-your-all attitude we love about our New York Captain!

Brunson is always ready to take the shot, make a great play, and put a smile on your face. Whether he’s zooming around, learning a new trick, or showing off his winning personality, this boy is definitely MVP material! He’s looking for his team to cheer him on, keep him active, and give him all the love he deserves.

Interested in meeting Brunson? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
